name: shirazeh.docs
description: Core documentation logic for Shirazeh: resolves page paths, loads markdown sources, and returns rendered pages with navigation context.

provides.name: shirazeh.docs.service
provides.description: Access to documentation pages and the sidebar navigation tree.

methods.name: getSidebar
methods.description: Returns the parsed sidebar navigation in two shapes: `links` is the flat level-annotated list, `tree` nests children under their parent by indent level (a child's level is greater than its parent's). The sidebar markdown file is fetched once and cached; subsequent calls reuse the cache. Links are reported exactly as authored (href, label text as title, optional markdown title attribute as attrTitle, indent level); path-to-route mapping is the caller's concern.
methods.returns: Promise<{ links: SidebarLink[], tree: SidebarNode[] } | object> — SidebarLink { href: string, title: string, attrTitle: string|null, level: number }; SidebarNode { href, title, attrTitle, level, children: SidebarNode[] } on success, or a standard Bonyan error object

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Resolves a documentation route path (like '/guide/setup' or '/' for the home page) to a rendered page: fetches the underlying markdown document via the HTTP transport, renders it to sanitized HTML through the markdown service — with the parsneshan Persian dialect extensions injected per the `extensions` configuration — and returns the page with its table of contents, title, and previous/next links derived from the sidebar. `title` is the first h1/h2 heading text; `documentTitle` follows the sidebar title-attribute → sidebar label → heading chain and is intended for the browser tab title. Publishes docs:page-loaded only on success.

params.name: path
params.type: string — route path, '/' maps to the configured homePage

methods.returns: Promise<PageData | object> — PageData { path, html, toc: Array<{id,level,text}>, title: string, documentTitle: string, previous: SidebarLink|null, next: SidebarLink|null } or a standard Bonyan error object

events.name: docs:page-loaded
events.description: Published after a documentation page has been successfully loaded and rendered.

data.name: path
data.type: string — the route path that was loaded
